concept: To make a mixture from two Quantity
question: A 40-litres mixture of acid and water contains acid and water in the ratio 3:1 . 8 litres of this mixture is removed and replaced with another solution of acid and water in the ratio 1:3 . What is the final ratio of acid to water in the resulting mixture?
solution: [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__ Remaining mixture volume = 40 − 8 = 32 litres. Acid in remaining = 32 × (3/4) = 24 litres and Water = 8 litres. Acid in added 8 litres (1:3 ratio) = 8 × (1/4) = 2 litres. Water in added 8 litres (1:3 ratio) = 8 × (3/4) = 6 litres. Total Acid = 24 + 2 = 26 litres | Total Water = 8 + 6 = 14 litres. Final Ratio = 26 : 14 = 13 : 7. **∴ The correct answer is 13:7.**
